entities.name: Mats Kihlström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mats Bernhard Kihlström is an ice hockey player who played for the Swedish national team. He won a bronze medal at the 1988 Winter Olympics. He played for Södertälje SK and Brynäs IF throughout his career and he played 147 matches for the Swedish national team he won a silver medal at the 1986 World Championships.
